comment_clean: Very good location, close to a central square at the river area. Street was noisy due to the summer festival that was going on but we knew this based on other reviews. Carlos was very helpful at check giving us suggestions for what to do, and answered questions that we had. We were able to store our luggage prior to the check in.
evidence: Street was noisy due to the summer festival that was going on.

comment_clean: Amazing location, spacious apartment, beautifully decorated! The only downside, it was hot! We knew there was no A/C and were hopping the Porto breeze would be enough to cool things down at night. Unfortunately being so close to the center means there was just too much noise to leave the windows open at night. We would definitely come back, but not during the summer.
evidence: the only downside, it was hot... there was just too much noise to leave the windows open at night

comment_clean: Amazing location and very good communication with the host. Lovely spacious studio and very clean. Quite loud at night with music playing in bar/restaurant below, it didn’t bother us at all as we can sleep through noise but just a heads up if you stay. The host always responded instantly and we had a fabulous time here, thank you!
evidence: Quite loud at night with music playing in bar/restaurant below.

comment_clean: Clean and well equipped studio. However is a basement, humid and has a musty smell. Easy check-in/out. Good communication.
evidence: but the basement, humid and has a musty smell

comment_clean: Excellent location! Communication with the host was great, check in was great. The place was clean. Only thing I will point out is that the front room with the single bed is street facing,so it is slightly louder in there on a busy night. The main bedroom is very quiet though. I loved my stay!
evidence: the front room with the single bed is street facing, so it is slightly louder in there on a busy night.

comment_clean: Great location, nice shower and a welcoming host! The walls were a bit thin but other than that I had a great stay.
evidence: The walls were a bit thin.

comment_clean: Thank you to all at Bloom apartments for making our first stay in Porto easy ! The guy ( maintenance) in the apartment was super friendly and very helpful ( thank you ) It’s a very busy area but wilt in the apartment the noise wasn’t too bad
evidence: It’s a very busy area but wilt in the apartment the noise wasn’t too bad.

comment_clean: It was a nice apartment, good location with lots of resturants around. Only thing that bothered me was that on Friday and Saturday there was loud music that started playing around midnight somewhere around that we heard well in the apartment.
evidence: Only thing that bothered me was that on Friday and Saturday there was loud music that started playing around midnight.

comment_clean: Amazing location. Apartment is simple and very spacious. It’s true what other reviews said about the smell- in the morning it was strong - but it was only a night, so no problem.
evidence: It’s true what other reviews said about the smell- in the morning it was strong.

comment_clean: Amazing location for your Porto stay. Easy communication and very helpful. The street is busy at night but you are right in the heart of the action. Spacious, clean and cool. Loved it
evidence: The street is busy at night.

comment_clean: The unit looks more beautiful and spacious than in the photos published. You have everything that you need for a traveler like us. The heating was working nicely. As an Asian, this is also the first time I used a European style bathroom/bidet and it was helpful for my bathroom needs. The room is not that soundproof though so you can hear footstep noises upstairs and some talking voices etc from the other room. Pedro's parents who welcomed us are also very kind, polite and made sure we have everything.
evidence: the room is not that soundproof though.

comment_clean: The apartment was located up a narrow lane close to the main road along the river. Nice restaurants, a bakery, a pharmacy, medical clinic and grocery nearby. You should know that there is a large flight of stairs to get up to it. Plus there were no instructions or information for any of the appliances or for the area. The apartment was comfortable, beds were nice. But, the attached house next door was being renovated/demolished so the noise during the day was rather annoying.
evidence: there were no instructions or information for any of the appliances. | the noise during the day was rather annoying.
